title: The hum line, once
logline: The motel from the lot at 3 AM, and under the page, once in the private work, the hum line. The desk lit, a shape at it. The page doesn't say why this night.

panels.composition: A small motel from its lot at three in the morning with only the office lit and the shape of a man at the desk, and a single thin horizontal line beneath the image.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a small roadside motel seen from its lot at three in the morning with only the office lit and the shape of a man at the desk, a single thin horizontal line drawn beneath the image, no words
image.notes: The one hum line in Vol. II (objects.md · the hum line).

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
